Requirement: An active compatible modular item with one empty mount.

Repulse (EC06)

ACTION • Roll 2+ • USES 3 • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Equipment + Might vs Fortitude

Range / Targeting: Self / Cone 3; every creature in the cone

Effect: Each successfully affected creature takes 1 Force Damage and is pushed 2 units directly away from you.

Surge 1: Push one successfully affected creature 1 additional unit. Once per use.

Surge 2: Deal +1 Force Damage to each successfully affected creature. Once per use.
system.flavor: A short cone of force and displacement.
